title: The Office - Interview Skills 10 - Concluding The Interview
audio: mp3/262. The Office - Interview Skills 10 - Concluding The Interview.mp3

segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and if you've been following along with us recently, you'll know that we have a series about interviewing in English.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，如果你最近一直跟着我们，你就会知道我们有一个关于英语面试的系列。

segments.en: And so today we have the very last episode of that series.
segments.zh: 所以今天我们有那个系列的最后一集。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today is the last part of our interview series and we're basically just saying goodbye and we're doing some other things when you're leaving an interview.
segments.zh: 今天是我们采访系列的最后一部分，我们基本上只是说再见，当你离开采访时，我们正在做一些其他事情。

segments.en: It's very important the things that you say.
segments.zh: 你说的话很重要。

segments.en: That's right because this is the last thing that you're going to do in the interview so it's what your interviewer will remember.
segments.zh: 没错，因为这是你在面试中要做的最后一件事，所以这是你的面试官会记住的。

segments.en: So let's take a listen to today's dialogue and we'll be back in a moment.
segments.zh: 所以让我们听听今天的对话，我们一会儿就回来。

segments.en: Well Rebecca, is there anything else you need to know for now?
segments.zh: 好吧，丽贝卡，你现在还有什么需要知道的吗？

segments.en: I don't think so Mr. Parsons.
segments.zh: 我不这么认为帕森斯先生。

segments.en: I think you have covered all the main points for me.
segments.zh: 我想你已经涵盖了我的所有要点。

segments.en: Okay, well listen.
segments.zh: 好吧，好好听。

segments.en: Here's my business card with my mobile number.
segments.zh: 这是我的名片和我的手机号码。

segments.en: If any other questions spring to mind, don't hesitate to contact me.
segments.zh: 如果有任何其他问题浮现在脑海中，请随时与我联系。

segments.en: Of course you can also call Ms. Childs too.
segments.zh: 当然，您也可以打电话给 Childs 女士。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: When can I expect to hear from you?
segments.zh: 我什么时候可以收到您的来信？

segments.en: Well we are finishing the short list interviews tomorrow so we will certainly have a decision made by early next week.
segments.zh: 入围候选人的面试明天就会完成，所以我们一定会在下周初作出决定。

segments.en: Ms. Childs will call you to discuss more on Monday or Tuesday.
segments.zh: 柴尔兹女士将在周一或周二打电话给您讨论更多。

segments.en: How does that sound?
segments.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

segments.en: That sounds perfect.
segments.zh: 听起来太合适了。

segments.en: Thank you very much for taking the time to speak to me Mr. Parsons.
segments.zh: 非常感谢您花时间与我交谈，帕森斯先生。

segments.en: The pleasure is all mine Rebecca.
segments.zh: 能与你交谈是我的荣幸，丽贝卡。

segments.en: I hope to hear from you very soon.
segments.zh: 我希望很快收到您的来信。

segments.en: Absolutely.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: Thanks for coming Rebecca.
segments.zh: 感谢丽贝卡的到来。

segments.en: Goodbye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Alright, great.
segments.zh: 好吧，太好了。

segments.en: So really good things from Rebecca.
segments.zh: 来自丽贝卡的非常好的东西。

segments.en: She said some very interesting things, key things there.
segments.zh: 她说了一些非常有趣的事情，关键的事情。

segments.en: So why don't we take a look at those on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不看看那些关于语言外卖的东西。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: At the beginning of the end of the interview, Rebecca says, listen, I think you have covered all the main points for me.
segments.zh: 在采访结束时，丽贝卡说，听着，我想你已经为我介绍了所有要点。

segments.en: So this is after Mr. Parsons asks her if she has questions.
segments.zh: 所以这是在帕森斯先生问她是否有问题之后。

segments.en: And this word covered is very important.
segments.zh: 涵盖的这个词非常重要。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So if we talk about cover, to cover the main points or to cover a topic, it means to discuss it thoroughly or to have it finished.
segments.zh: 因此，如果我们谈论封面、涵盖要点或涵盖某个主题，则意味着彻底讨论或完成。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So if I still have questions, we have not covered everything.
segments.zh: 所以如果我还有问题，我们还没有涵盖所有内容。

segments.en: But if I did ask all the questions that I have, then we've covered everything.
segments.zh: 但是，如果我确实问了我所有的问题，那么我们已经涵盖了所有内容。

segments.en: So the verb here is to cover.
segments.zh: 所以这里的动词是覆盖。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So Rebecca says, well, you know what, here's my business card with my mobile number.
segments.zh: 所以丽贝卡说，好吧，你知道吗，这是我的名片和我的手机号码。

segments.en: So this word business card, key element of any interview or any business situation.
segments.zh: 所以这个词名片，任何面试或任何业务情况的关键要素。

segments.en: As you say, a key part of any business interaction.
segments.zh: 正如您所说，任何业务互动的关键部分。

segments.en: So a business card is a very small card, usually thick, and it has a person's name, job, phone number and sometimes email address now on the card.
segments.zh: 所以名片是一张很小的卡，通常很厚，它现在卡上有一个人的名字、工作、电话号码，有时还有电子邮件地址。

segments.en: So the information can change, but it's a contact card basically for one person.
segments.zh: 所以信息可以改变，但它基本上是一个人的联系卡。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it's important to have around, especially in situations like this.
segments.zh: 因此，在这种情况下，尤其是在这种情况下，这很重要。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And moving on, he also told her that if she has any other questions to not hesitate and to contact him.
segments.zh: 继续前进，他还告诉她，如果她有任何其他问题可以毫不犹豫地联系他。

segments.en: This is a very common phrase.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常常见的短语。

segments.en: Don't hesitate to contact me or don't hesitate to ask.
segments.zh: 不要犹豫与我联系或不要犹豫询问。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So to hesitate means to be nervous about something or to maybe not do it because you're uncomfortable.
segments.zh: 所以犹豫意味着对某事感到紧张，或者因为你不舒服而不这样做。

segments.en: So, you know, Marco, I want to ask you something, but I'm not sure if I want to ask you, maybe you'll be angry or so.
segments.zh: 所以，你知道，马可，我想问你一件事，但我不确定我是否想问你，也许你会生气左右。

segments.en: I'm hesitating.
segments.zh: 我在犹豫。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: The verb here is to hesitate.
segments.zh: 这里的动词是犹豫。

segments.en: You have doubts.
segments.zh: 你有疑问。

segments.en: I have doubts.
segments.zh: 我有疑问。

segments.en: And so he says, don't hesitate to contact me.
segments.zh: 所以他说，不要犹豫与我联系。

segments.en: That means any questions, any issues, please call me.
segments.zh: 这意味着任何问题，任何问题，请给我打电话。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: And Mr. Parson said that they are finishing the short list of interviews tomorrow.
segments.zh: 帕森先生说，他们明天将完成简短的采访清单。

segments.en: So what does it mean a short list?
segments.zh: 那么短名单是什么意思呢？

segments.en: Well, a short list is something we talk about during the interview process because the interviewer, so in this case, Mr. Parsons will have a long list of people who want the job.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们在面试过程中谈论的是简短的清单，因为面试官，所以在这种情况下，帕森斯先生将有一长串想要这份工作的人。

segments.en: And maybe after the first interview, he will cut the list down to a very small number of people, 10 or 15.
segments.zh: 也许在第一次采访之后，他会将名单减少到极少数人，10 或 15 人。

segments.en: And that is called the short list.
segments.zh: 这就是所谓的短名单。

segments.en: So those are the people who did well on the first interview, but who maybe should come back for a second or third interview.
segments.zh: 所以那些在第一次采访中表现出色的人，但他们可能应该回来接受第二次或第三次采访。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: A lot of great things there.
segments.zh: 那里有很多很棒的东西。

segments.en: Why don't we take a break?
segments.zh: 我们为什么不休息一下？

segments.en: Let's go back and listen to the dialogue.
segments.zh: 让我们回去听对话。

segments.en: Let's see what Mr. Parsons and Rebecca said.
segments.zh: 让我们看看帕森斯先生和丽贝卡说了什么。

segments.en: And we'll be back with some really good phrases that you can close off an interview with.
segments.zh: 我们会带着一些非常好的短语回来，你可以结束采访。

segments.en: Well, Rebecca, is there anything else you need to know for now?
segments.zh: 好吧，丽贝卡，你现在还有什么需要知道的吗？

segments.en: I don't think so, Mr. Parsons.
segments.zh: 我不这么认为，帕森斯先生。

segments.en: I think you have covered all the main points for me.
segments.zh: 我想你已经涵盖了我的所有要点。

segments.en: Okay, well, listen.
segments.zh: 好吧，听着。

segments.en: Here's my business card with my mobile number.
segments.zh: 这是我的名片和我的手机号码。

segments.en: If any other questions spring to mind, don't hesitate to contact me.
segments.zh: 如果有任何其他问题浮现在脑海中，请随时与我联系。

segments.en: Of course, you can also call Ms. Childs, too.
segments.zh: 当然，您也可以打电话给 Childs 女士。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: When can I expect to hear from you?
segments.zh: 我什么时候可以收到您的来信？

segments.en: Well, we are finishing the short list interviews tomorrow, so we will certainly have a decision made by early next week.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们明天将完成短名单采访，所以我们肯定会在下周初做出决定。

segments.en: Ms. Childs will call you to discuss more on Monday or Tuesday.
segments.zh: 柴尔兹女士将在周一或周二打电话给您讨论更多。

segments.en: How does that sound?
segments.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

segments.en: That sounds perfect.
segments.zh: 听起来太合适了。

segments.en: Thank you very much for taking the time to speak to me, Mr. Parsons.
segments.zh: 非常感谢您花时间与我交谈，帕森斯先生。

segments.en: The pleasure is all mine, Rebecca.
segments.zh: 快乐是我的，丽贝卡。

segments.en: I hope to hear from you very soon.
segments.zh: 我希望很快收到您的来信。

segments.en: Absolutely.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: Thanks for coming, Rebecca.
segments.zh: 谢谢你的到来，丽贝卡。

segments.en: Goodbye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now let's take a look at those phrases we mentioned on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们来看看我们在 Fluency Builder 上提到的那些短语。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: So let's go back to the beginning where Mr. Parsons is talking about questions that Rebecca might have.
segments.zh: 因此，让我们回到帕森斯先生正在谈论丽贝卡可能遇到的问题的开头。

segments.en: And so Mr. Parsons says, if any other questions spring to mind, don't hesitate to contact me.
segments.zh: 所以帕森斯先生说，如果想到任何其他问题，请不要犹豫与我联系。

segments.en: So this phrase, spring to mind, is very interesting.
segments.zh: 所以这句话，脑海中浮现，非常有趣。

segments.en: What does this mean?
segments.zh: 这是什么意思？

segments.en: Well, basically if something springs to your mind or springs to mind, it means that it comes very suddenly and quickly into your mind.
segments.zh: 好吧，基本上，如果有什么东西出现在你的脑海或脑海中浮现，这意味着它会突然迅速进入你的脑海。

segments.en: It just pops into your head.
segments.zh: 它只是突然出现在你的脑海中。

segments.en: Wow.
segments.zh: 哇。

segments.en: So to spring or springs in this case is like jumping.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，弹簧或弹簧就像跳跃。

segments.en: So something hits your mind very quickly, comes into your mind very quickly.
segments.zh: 所以有什么东西很快就击中了你的脑海，很快就进入了你的脑海。

segments.en: So oh, I don't really have any ideas, Marco, for that party next week, but if anything springs to mind, you should let me know.
segments.zh: 所以哦，我真的没有任何想法，马可下周的那个派对，但如果有什么想法，你应该告诉我。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: If you have any sudden ideas or anything you suddenly remember, that's what it means to spring to mind.
segments.zh: 如果你有任何突然的想法或任何突然想起的东西，这就是脑海中浮现的意义。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So taking a look at these expressions that Rebecca used when she's leaving, for example, you know that you finished the interview and a typical question that you want to make is, when can I expect to hear from you?
segments.zh: 因此，看看 Rebecca 离开时使用的这些表达方式，例如，您知道您完成了采访，而您想提出的一个典型问题是，我什么时候可以收到您的来信？

segments.en: This is a great question at the end of an interview because it's basically a way of saying, listen, I'm interested in this job.
segments.zh: 这是面试结束时的一个很好的问题，因为它基本上是一种表达方式，听着，我对这份工作很感兴趣。

segments.en: When will you call me about it?
segments.zh: 你什么时候给我打电话？

segments.en: And so the phrase, when can I expect to hear from you means, when will you tell me your decision?
segments.zh: 所以这句话，我什么时候可以期待听到你的意思，你什么时候会告诉我你的决定？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: But it's a lot more polite and formal and better than saying, when are you going to call me?
segments.zh: 但这比说，你打算什么时候给我打电话要礼貌和正式得多？

segments.en: Yeah, you would never say that in an interview because it makes you sound desperate, like you really need the job.
segments.zh: 是的，你永远不会在面试中这么说，因为它让你听起来很绝望，就像你真的需要这份工作一样。

segments.en: In this case, you know, when can I expect to hear from you?
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，你知道，我什么时候可以收到你的来信？

segments.en: It's like, oh, well, you know, I hope that you'll get in touch with me.
segments.zh: 就像，哦，好吧，你知道，我希望你能与我取得联系。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So she explained that they're shortlisting everything and that they will be in touch with her very soon.
segments.zh: 所以她解释说，他们正在将所有内容列入候选名单，并且他们将很快与她取得联系。

segments.en: And she said, wow, that sounds perfect.
segments.zh: 她说，哇，这听起来很完美。

segments.en: Thank you very much for taking the time to speak to me.
segments.zh: 非常感谢您花时间与我交谈。

segments.en: Okay, so this phrase, thank you very much for taking the time to speak to me, it's very long.
segments.zh: 好的，这句话，非常感谢您花时间与我交谈，这很长。

segments.en: But you know what thank you very much means.
segments.zh: 但你知道谢谢你的意思。

segments.en: The key here is for taking the time to do something.
segments.zh: 这里的关键是花时间做某事。

segments.en: Now what does this mean?
segments.zh: 现在这是什么意思？

segments.en: What's another way we can use this?
segments.zh: 我们可以使用它的另一种方式是什么？

segments.en: It's basically saying thank you so much for giving me an opportunity to talk to you.
segments.zh: 它基本上是在说非常感谢你给我一个与你交谈的机会。

segments.en: I know you're very busy and I know you don't have a lot of time.
segments.zh: 我知道你很忙，我知道你没有很多时间。

segments.en: So thank you very much for taking the time to speak to me.
segments.zh: 所以非常感谢你花时间和我说话。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So you could even use this with a teacher at school.
segments.zh: 所以你甚至可以在学校的老师身上使用它。

segments.en: You know, you have a question, your teacher is busy, but your teacher makes some time to meet with you.
segments.zh: 你知道，你有一个问题，你的老师很忙，但你的老师会抽出一些时间和你见面。

segments.en: You say, hey, listen, professor or listen, teacher, thank you so much for taking the time to speak to me.
segments.zh: 你说，嘿，听，教授或听，老师，非常感谢你花时间和我说话。

segments.en: You're just demonstrating that you appreciate the effort and the time.
segments.zh: 你只是在证明你欣赏努力和时间。

segments.en: And you're being very polite.
segments.zh: 你很有礼貌。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And then the last phrase, when Rebecca is leaving the room, they're shaking hands maybe and Rebecca says, I hope to hear from you very soon.
segments.zh: 然后最后一句话，当丽贝卡离开房间时，他们可能正在握手，丽贝卡说，我希望很快能收到你的来信。

segments.en: You can say I hope to hear from you soon.
segments.zh: 你可以说我希望很快能收到你的来信。

segments.en: But in this case, she's saying, listen, I really want this job.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，她说，听着，我真的很想要这份工作。

segments.en: She doesn't want to say, call me, you know, call me tomorrow.
segments.zh: 她不想说，打电话给我，你知道，明天给我打电话。

segments.en: She says, I hope to hear from you soon.
segments.zh: 她说，我希望很快能收到你的来信。

segments.en: I hope that this works out that I get the job.
segments.zh: 我希望这能让我得到这份工作。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So she's basically demonstrating a lot of interest saying, well, I really like the job and I really would like for you to call me and give me good news.
segments.zh: 所以她基本上表现出很多兴趣，好吧，我真的很喜欢这份工作，我真的很想让你打电话给我，给我好消息。

segments.en: So I hope to hear from you soon.
segments.zh: 所以我希望很快能收到你的来信。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So let's listen to today's dialogue one more time and we'll be back in a moment to talk a little bit more about how to end an interview.
segments.zh: 所以让我们再听一次今天的对话，我们稍后会再来谈谈如何结束采访。

segments.en: Well Rebecca, is there anything else you need to know for now?
segments.zh: 好吧，丽贝卡，你现在还有什么需要知道的吗？

segments.en: I don't think so, Mr. Parsons.
segments.zh: 我不这么认为，帕森斯先生。

segments.en: I think you have covered all the main points for me.
segments.zh: 我想你已经涵盖了我的所有要点。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Well, listen, here's my business card with my mobile number.
segments.zh: 好吧，听着，这是我的名片和我的手机号码。

segments.en: If any other questions spring to mind, don't hesitate to contact me.
segments.zh: 如果有任何其他问题浮现在脑海中，请随时与我联系。

segments.en: Of course, you can also call Ms. Childs too.
segments.zh: 当然，您也可以打电话给 Childs 女士。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: Um, when can I expect to hear from you?
segments.zh: 嗯，我什么时候可以收到你的来信？

segments.en: Well, we are finishing the short list interviews tomorrow, so we will certainly have a decision made by early next week.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们明天将完成短名单采访，所以我们肯定会在下周初做出决定。

segments.en: Ms. Childs will call you to discuss more on Monday or Tuesday.
segments.zh: 柴尔兹女士将在周一或周二打电话给您讨论更多。

segments.en: How does that sound?
segments.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

segments.en: That sounds perfect.
segments.zh: 听起来太合适了。

segments.en: Thank you very much for taking the time to speak to me, Mr. Parsons.
segments.zh: 非常感谢您花时间与我交谈，帕森斯先生。

segments.en: The pleasure is all mine, Rebecca.
segments.zh: 快乐是我的，丽贝卡。

segments.en: I hope to hear from you very soon.
segments.zh: 我希望很快收到您的来信。

segments.en: Absolutely.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: Thanks for coming, Rebecca.
segments.zh: 谢谢你的到来，丽贝卡。

segments.en: Goodbye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: So this is a great way of ending an interview.
segments.zh: 所以这是结束采访的好方法。

segments.en: Rebecca did a really good job, and I think there are a couple of suggestions or tips that you would like to give our users.
segments.zh: Rebecca 做得非常好，我认为您想为我们的用户提供一些建议或提示。

segments.en: Yeah, well, one of them is don't, at the end of the interview, ask the person if you have the job.
segments.zh: 是的，好吧，其中之一是不要，在面试结束时，问问这个人你是否有工作。

segments.en: They'll say, we will be in touch, or thank you so much for coming in.
segments.zh: 他们会说，我们会与您联系，或者非常感谢您的光临。

segments.en: But if they don't say, we would really like to have you join this company, then you probably shouldn't ask.
segments.zh: 但如果他们不说，我们真的很想让你加入这家公司，那么你可能不应该问。

segments.en: You should say, you know, when can I expect to hear from you?
segments.zh: 你应该说，你知道，我什么时候可以收到你的来信？

segments.en: That's more polite.
segments.zh: 那更有礼貌。

segments.en: Because I think a lot of times, if you didn't get the job, it makes the interviewer feel very uncomfortable.
segments.zh: 因为我想很多时候，如果你没有得到这份工作，这会让面试官感到非常不舒服。

segments.en: But also, it's just a polite thing to do.
segments.zh: 而且，这只是礼貌的事情。

segments.en: So be careful with that.
segments.zh: 所以要小心。

segments.en: And I've also been told from people in business that if you do receive a job offer, don't accept right away.
segments.zh: 而且我还被商业人士告知，如果您确实收到了工作机会，请不要立即接受。

segments.en: Say I will think about it, and I'll get back in touch with you.
segments.zh: 说我会考虑的，我会和你重新联系。

segments.en: Oh, OK.
segments.zh: 哦，好的。

segments.en: Kind of like a strategy maybe to better negotiate the terms and conditions.
segments.zh: 有点像一种策略，也许是为了更好地谈判条款和条件。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So you want to take that information, you want to go home, you want to think about it, talk about it with your wife or your husband, and decide, is this something I want?
segments.zh: 所以你想获取这些信息，你想回家，你想考虑一下，和你的妻子或丈夫谈论它，然后决定，这是我想要的吗？

segments.en: And then you can contact the employer.
segments.zh: 然后你可以联系雇主。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Yeah, I think that's a very good idea.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为这是一个非常好的主意。

segments.en: And also, I think it's not a wise thing to call or contact the employer asking if you've got the job or asking if they have any news yet, because I think that can be a little bit annoying.
segments.zh: 而且，我认为打电话或联系雇主询问您是否有工作或询问他们是否有任何消息不是明智之举，因为我认为这可能有点烦人。

segments.en: But if they say, we will be in touch on Tuesday, and it's a week later, and they never got back to you, send a follow up.
segments.zh: 但如果他们说，我们将在周二与您联系，而且是一周后，他们再也没有回复您，请发送跟进。

segments.en: Of course.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: A follow up is an email or a letter or even a phone call where you say, listen, I'm really glad I got to meet you today.
segments.zh: 跟进是一封电子邮件或一封信，甚至是一个电话，你说，听着，我真的很高兴今天能见到你。

segments.en: I hope that we have the opportunity to work together in the future.
segments.zh: 我希望我们有机会在未来共同努力。

segments.en: Always be in touch.
segments.zh: 始终保持联系。

segments.en: Sincerely, and then your name.
segments.zh: 真诚的，然后是你的名字。

segments.en: Kind of like a reminder.
segments.zh: 有点像提醒。

segments.en: It's a reminder, like, I want the job.
segments.zh: 这是一个提醒，就像，我想要这份工作。

segments.en: Here's my information.
segments.zh: 这是我的信息。

segments.en: Let's do this.
segments.zh: 我们开始吧。

segments.en: Or at least if I didn't get the job, let me know that I didn't get it.
segments.zh: 或者至少如果我没有得到这份工作，让我知道我没有得到它。

segments.en: Yeah, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So a lot of great advice here.
segments.zh: 所以这里有很多很好的建议。

segments.en: Great things coming.
segments.zh: 伟大的事情即将到来。

segments.en: And we'll be back again with another series.
segments.zh: 我们将再次带着另一个系列回来。

segments.en: We're going to have a presentation series.
segments.zh: 我们将有一个演示系列。

segments.en: So be sure to keep an eye out for that.
segments.zh: 所以一定要留意这一点。

segments.en: And if you have any other questions or comments, we're always at EnglishPod.com where you can find us.
segments.zh: 如果您有任何其他问题或意见，我们随时可以在 Englishpod.com 找到我们。

segments.en: We'll see you there.
segments.zh: 到时候见。

segments.en: Bye-bye.
segments.zh: 拜拜。
